questions.title: Where do you need the work to accept you?
questions.help: Eligibility is country-specific. We only use this to filter out routes that are closed to you.

questions.title: How much time could you realistically give most weeks?
questions.help: Realistic beats ambitious. You can change this later.

questions.title: Are those times a firm limit?
questions.help: If firm, we hide routes with fixed shifts outside your times.

questions.title: How do you prefer to deal with people at work?
questions.help: There is no right answer. Plenty of good work is mostly solo.

options.label: Mostly by text: chat or email
Live calls or video are fine

questions.title: And phone or voice calls specifically?
questions.help: Phone comfort is separate from being sociable.

questions.title: What would help most right now?
questions.help: Pick as many as are true. Wanting money soon and a better long-term route can coexist.

questions.title: How comfortable are you with computers today?
questions.help: “Today” is the point. This is about now, not what you could learn.

options.label: Confident: I pick up new tools fast

questions.title: How do these kinds of work feel?
questions.help: Answer only the ones you have a feel for. “Not sure” is treated as neutral.

questions.title: Are you open to training before you earn?

options.label: Yes, if it leads somewhere real

questions.title: What do you have access to?
questions.help: Pick all that apply. Skip if you’d rather not say. Nothing is ruled out except routes that need a computer, if you say you don’t have one.

questions.title: Anything that is a firm no?
questions.help: These are hard filters. Leave empty if nothing is.

options.label: Fees or commission to take part
Contractor status (I want to be an employee)

questions.title: Is there a pay floor?
questions.help: Many routes don’t publish pay. Unknown pay is shown with a caveat, not hidden.

questions.title: Are you 18 or older?
questions.help: Some routes have age rules. Optional.

notes.skipped: An unanswered question is null (or {} for the matrix). The engine treats it as neutral.
notes.multi: A multi-select with nothing ticked is null (skipped), not an empty list. The value "__none" is an explicit "none of these" and is stored as [].
notes.when: A question with a `when` condition is only asked when conditionHolds(when, profile) is true. Tests: not, gt, minLength, maxLength on profile[key].
